name: Spontaneous Summon Fey (Mythic)
body:
You can cast more of your spells spontaneously.

Prerequisite(s): Spontaneous Summon Fey.

Benefit(s): You can use your spontaneous casting ability to cast domain spells or spirit spells that you did not prepare ahead of time.

The Bardess’ Library #7: Fey, © 2025, Legendary Games; Author: Margherita Tramontano.
